timestamp_derivation: After the acceptance path was proven on a disposable PG16 and the four counters unified; before the author timestamp of the commit that introduces this receipt. Per T0091, in the order T0108 requires.
reported_by: Product Owner: four screens disagreed about outstanding PMS work (1 vs 13 717), and asked whether any of it required manual review.

counter_defect.found: The dashboard and reconciliation page were corrected in D47 to count outstanding work; the PMS connection row and the Property-management card were missed and went on counting every MANUAL_REVIEW row ever recorded.
counter_defect.effect: The same appliance reported 1 outstanding on two screens and 13 717 on two others. 13 716 of those already carried a disposition.
counter_defect.fix: iam_v2.pms_unanswered_review_events is now the single definition of outstanding PMS work, and all four counters read it.

acceptance.what: The one remaining exception -- a live departure naming a reservation for which no arrival was ever received -- is administratively accepted as a startup data gap.
acceptance.disposition: ACCEPTED_STARTUP_DATA_GAP with evidence_kind OPERATOR_DECISION, deliberately distinct from every evidence-based disposition: it records what a person chose, not what the data showed.
acceptance.preserved: The stay_event is untouched -- MANUAL_REVIEW, GO_UNKNOWN_STAY, payload and timestamps as written. Nothing deleted, no stay changed state.
acceptance.cannot_be_abused: The function takes ONE event id and refuses: a missing operator, a missing reason, anything that is not an unanswered live departure, and any record that already carries a disposition. Proven that a NEW exception arriving after an acceptance is still counted and still raises its blocker.

guest_state: Unchanged. The guest concerned departed in August and holds no session, entitlement or device on this appliance.

previous_state.lifecycle: post-roadmap production preparation (not a numbered phase; no Phase 8)

new_state.lifecycle: post-roadmap production preparation (not a numbered phase; no Phase 8)

authorization: Product Owner, 2026-09-14: complete the administrative closure of the single historical exception as an accepted startup data gap, preserving its original record and audit trail, without affecting guest state or future exceptions.
